transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rights issue. I have the executed and countersigned archive license for The Glass Harbor. It permits exactly one live public performance of the film, but it explicitly prohibits any audio or video recording of the screening. The current event sheet includes an archival recording for the festival collection, which would violate the license terms. Additionally, the license requires that the screening credit 'The Glass Harbor Preservation Trust.' I received the countersigned license after the draft event sheet circulated, and I have not yet attached it to that sheet. I'm doing so now, but the event sheet must be amended to remove the archival recording and add the required credit before Mara can sign off.
